boundary: One local search-gate campaign process. Scientific scores and selection order are outside this observation and remain bound by the deterministic campaign digest.
claim_boundary: Energy is an active-duration proxy estimate with coefficient bounds, not measured electricity or carbon. Peak memory is a sampled process lower bound.

assumptions: The bounded proposer executes in one worker process; ExtraTrees uses n_jobs=1.
Search memory is whole-worker resident memory during the boundary, not incremental proposer allocation; unrelated concurrent worker activity may be included.
The energy value is a wall-time power proxy, not a meter reading.
Concurrent jobs are estimated independently from their own active durations.
resource_observation.boundary_description: One complete local search release-gate campaign, including random, Sobol, and Sobol-plus-ExtraTrees proposal replays.
exclusions: Python orchestration, file synchronization, display, networking, cooling, and embodied energy are outside the estimate boundary.
Sampled process memory may miss peaks between samples and is a lower bound.
No location-based electricity or carbon conversion is performed.
